input: Organize a clothing swap with neighborhood friends

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing what types of clothing are included (all ages, gendered, accessories, shoes, kids) determines how the swap is categorized and run.
The number of participants directly affects venue size, quantity of items, and how the swap mechanics are structured.
Whether it is indoors or outdoors, and at whose home or a shared space, shapes the setup and logistics entirely.
A target date or deadline determines urgency and how much lead time is available for invitations and preparation.
The format of the swap (free-for-all, ticket system, rounds) changes the rules, fairness, and flow of the event significantly.
The desired atmosphere (casual backyard hangout vs. styled pop-up event) affects decoration, communication tone, and overall experience.
Knowing what to do with leftover items (donate, return to owners, discard) defines a clear end-state and prevents post-event confusion.

gold.taskTitle: Organize a neighborhood clothing swap event
gold.taskDescription: Plan and host a clothing swap event with friends from the neighborhood, covering all logistics from invitations to the swap itself.

questions.title: What types of clothing or items will be included?
questions.description: Clarify whether the swap covers all clothing (men, women, kids), or is limited to a specific category like women's only, and whether accessories or shoes are included.

questions.title: How many neighbors are you expecting to invite?
questions.description: Determine the approximate headcount to plan venue space, item volume, and swap mechanics accordingly.

questions.title: Where will the swap be held?
questions.description: Establish whether it takes place at someone's home, a backyard, a community space, or another venue to plan setup and capacity.

questions.title: Do you have a target date in mind already?
questions.description: Identify whether there is a specific date or timeframe to work toward, which sets the planning timeline and urgency.

questions.title: How should the actual swapping process work?
questions.description: Decide on the format — such as a free-for-all browse, a ticket-based system, or structured rounds — to define the rules and flow of the event.

questions.title: What kind of atmosphere or vibe are you going for?
questions.description: Determine whether the event should feel like a casual hangout, a styled boutique-style pop-up, or something in between, to guide tone and presentation.

questions.title: What happens to unclaimed clothes after the swap?
questions.description: Clarify the plan for leftover items — donated to charity, returned to owners, or disposed of — to ensure a clear and tidy end to the event.
